Definition: from G4149; to make wealthy (figuratively):--en- (make) rich.
BiblicalUsage: Ploutizo means to make rich, to enrich. In everything ye are enriched by Him, says 1 Corinthians 1:5, and Paul calls himself poor, yet making many rich, in 2 Corinthians 6:10. You are enriched in everything to all bountifulness, says 2 Corinthians 9:11.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the poorest apostle made others rich, and that is the only wealth worth having.
